purpose: Freeze and audit the GE19 H4F2g source-only Ward time coordinate before any full corrected-parent source/operator/Noether evaluation. With x=ln(a), require physical d_t=H(x)d_x using unchanged Repair37 FD8 for the GE06/GE07/Lambda source family and unchanged Repair07 FD4 for the GE05 memory source family. Compare source-only D_S with exact manufactured functions and expose mixed-derivative representation; no physical parent sampling or H4/Z21 solve.

exact_geometry.background_H: H=(1/a) da/dt, frozen positive GE19 background
exact_geometry.legacy_H4F2g_derivative: np.gradient(S_b,time) is only physically meaningful if time is physical t; feeding x=ln(a) without H is forbidden
exact_geometry.FD8_R37: frozen ninth-point degree-eight-exact derivative matrix on uniform x grid, original GE06/GE07/Lambda H4 path
exact_geometry.FD4_R07: frozen five-point fourth-order derivative matrix on uniform x grid, original GE05 memory H4 path
exact_geometry.separate_family_derivatives: Retain FD8 for nonmemory GE06+GE07+Lambda, FD4 for GE05 M2 when reproducing historical per-piece source; do not silently form FD8 derivative of FD4-created M2 or pass a mixed source into a single derivative without a registered compatibility test

tests.wrong_clock_negative_control: H4F2g old d/dx result at supplied x must differ measurably from manufactured physical d/dt when nonconstant H != 1
tests.linearity: Correct physical Ward of sum equals sum of same-scheme piece Wards; no termwise zero claim
tests.zero_constraint_Y_M1: M1 and Y have zero shift, isotropic and anisotropy in fixed source dictionary and exactly zero source-Ward projection
tests.FD8_vs_FD4_difference_reported: Do not claim equality at finite Nt for nonlinear synthetic shift traces; record max relative difference and do not use it as fitted correction

outcomes.PHYSICAL_CLOCK_DISCRETE_WARD_BRIDGE_PASS: Pin full 8-row source Ward clock/FD semantics and manufactured accuracy only; freeze corrected standalone helper and preregister full common-parent/source/operator/parent-residual test separately.
outcomes.PHYSICAL_CLOCK_DISCRETE_WARD_BRIDGE_FAIL: Freeze exact clock, derivative, source-sign or projection defect; do not change old H4F2g PASS classification or run H4 science.
